summary: Configured node1 to run nginx in a rootless Podman container owned by appsvc. OpenRC starts it at boot without an appsvc login session. A final reboot confirmed persistence and recovery on port 8080.
actions_performed: Installed Podman and rootless runtime dependencies.
Created appsvc with /sbin/nologin and subordinate UID/GID mappings.
Created and enabled the appsvc-web OpenRC service.
Corrected boot-time creation of /run/user and appsvc's runtime directory.
Completed a final successful reboot-and-recovery test.

evidence.summary: appsvc is UID 1001 with /sbin/nologin; Podman, networking, conmon, and nginx processes run as appsvc.
Container is running with 0.0.0.0:8080 mapped to port 80; HTTP returned 200 with the nginx page.

evidence.requirement: Starts at boot without an active login session
evidence.summary: OpenRC boot configuration survived reboot; appsvc-web recovered automatically while appsvc_login_sessions remained 0.

Healthy baseline used boot ID aa5293f4-bba8-45cb-b430-3176c139b27e; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to 36a5b03e-1178-4784-9422-4c3e18e2ca51; service, container, listener, login-session state, and identical HTTP body checksum were verified after recovery.
